items.claim: Spivak has been knocked out four times in his career.
items.quote: He's also been knocked out four times.

items.claim: Petrino has faced a weak level of competition at heavyweight.
items.quote: a little bit of weak competition at heavyweight, if we're being honest here.

items.claim: Spivac will be durable enough to neutralize Petrino and avoid an early finish.
items.quote: I think he'll be a little bit more durable, just enough to sort of neutralize Petrino, so he's not able to get that, you know, that early finish

items.claim: De Ridder left Kill Cliff due to some issues over there and went to ATT.
items.quote: He actually left Kill Cliff. I guess there were some issues over there.

items.claim: De Ridder has an impressive submission game with 14 total submissions.
items.quote: Really good submission game, 14 submissions total. So, that's very impressive.

items.claim: Roman Dolidze's past issues have been related to his weight cut.
items.quote: I think a lot of his issues that he's had were weight cut related

items.claim: Anthony Hernandez's durability is good enough to survive an early onslaught from Rodrigues.
items.quote: I think his durability is good enough to survive that early onslaught.

items.claim: Anthony Hernandez has good cardio and a good ground game for a five-round fight.
items.quote: you know he's got good cardio and he's got a good ground game, good good stand-up.

items.claim: Gregory Rodrigues gassed out in his loss to Jared Cannonier because he couldn't put him away early.
items.quote: kind of gassed out in that one cuz part of it was he couldn't put Cannonier away early.
